facts.fact: FAO GIEWS runs an Earth Observation portal giving Comoros an Agricultural Stress Index and drought-intensity indicators from METOP-AVHRR satellite vegetation data, to identify cropped land at risk of drought.
facts.system: FAO GIEWS Earth Observation (Agricultural Stress Index)

facts.fact: FAO GIEWS says the Comoros country maps and graphs show the latest 36 months of vegetation and precipitation indicators, presented by dekad (10 days) and month, with a near-real-time view.
facts.system: FAO GIEWS Earth Observation (Agricultural Stress Index)

systems.system: FAO GIEWS Earth Observation country indicators (ASI, Drought Intensity, Weighted Mean VHI)
